summary: Iter-76 BRSF Star Reward regression verified end-to-end. Backend (pytest, 8/8): N03 uses duration equivalents (system_note 'Emergency leave equivalent X day(s)…'), value strictly 0 (<=2.0) or -3 (>2.0) — no -6/-9 anywhere; N03 children each carry equivalent 0.5 or 1.0. N01 lists ALL leave records regardless of type (Adwaid Aug-2026 has 8 children: 2 Preplanned, 5 Paid, 1 Emergency), each child exposes leave_validity + reason + value in {0,-1}. child-override endpoint rejects -2/1/0.5 (400) and accepts -1/0, reset works. Overall Star API returns active-first then inactive with names ascending within each group; Sep-2026 recalculate blocked (400); Auto Calculate for Aug-2026 idempotent (no net_total drift). Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): N01 child grid renders exactly the required 12 columns (Leave Date/Type/Duration/Applied Date/Applied Time/Leave Validity/Notes/System Star/Override/Final Star/Status/Action); all dates DD-MM-YYYY and times hh:mm AM/PM (0 ISO leaks, 0 24h times in the whole detail HTML). Notes eye buttons present with data-testid=brsf-reason-leave:{id}, dialog shows 'Leave Details — 22-08-2026', 'Employee leave reason', 'System decision' as separate blocks. N03 header label: 'Emergency leave equivalent 0.5 day(s) (Full Day 1.0 / Half Day 0.5); up to 2.0 allowed'. Overall Star tab: 21 Active first then 4 Inactive badges ('Inactive 07-08-2026', 'Inactive 21-07-2026', 'Inactive 15-07-2026', 'Inactive 11-07-2026') — DD-MM-YYYY confirmed, 0 ISO leaks. Unit probe /app/backend/tests/n01_precedence_probe.py: 13/13 N01 + 5/5 N03 cases still PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still ~20k lines — not this iteration's fault but continues to worsen; brsf_stars.py at 857 lines is approaching the 700-line threshold.

brsf_stars.py:24 imports api_router from server, and brsf_overall.py:16 imports from server — the circular-import warning ('BRSF star module load failed: cannot import name _month_is_completed …') printed by the n01_precedence_probe when it imports brsf_stars stand-alone is harmless in-app (server imports brsf_stars in order) but indicates the module is only usable inside the running FastAPI process.

N01 child value validation currently reflects the {0,-1} rule; confirm the same rule is enforced on parent overrides for the N01 code (parent should still support the full negative cap). Not observed to break, worth an explicit unit test.
brsf_child_override returns 400 with a clean detail on out-of-range values; consider unifying to 422 with Pydantic validation for consistency with the rest of the API surface.
